text: dsh-lanbuddy-pair 是一个面向网页端 DSH 的扫码配对插件，可让手机连接电脑当前运行的 DSH 实例。它在设置页加入「扫码配对」界面，展示由当前认证地址生成的二维码和连接信息；当 DSH 只监听本机回环地址时，还会启动局域网网关并转发 HTTP 与 WebSocket 请求。用户可在浏览器查看配对页或二维码，也可撤销所有已配对设备。适合希望从手机访问电脑 DSH 的用户；需要手机和电脑通过局域网互通，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-lanbuddy-pair adds QR pairing to DSH Settings so a phone can connect to a computer running DSH. It uses the current authenticated address and starts a LAN gateway for loopback instances, forwarding HTTP and WebSocket traffic. Users can open a pairing page and revoke devices.
想用手机接着操作电脑上正在运行的 DSH。
怎么把手机和本地 DSH 实例快速配对？
希望在设置页直接显示可供手机扫描的连接二维码。
桌面版只监听 localhost，怎样让同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机连上？
How can I pair my phone with the DSH session running on my computer?
Can I show a scannable connection QR code inside DSH settings?
dsh-lanbuddy-pair 的功能「设置页扫码配对」：在 DSH 设置中添加扫码配对面板，读取当前连接地址并显示二维码；用户用手机扫描即可取得可访问的实例地址。
dsh-lanbuddy-pair 的功能「回环实例局域网转发」：当 DSH 仅监听本机回环地址时，自动尝试在局域网地址开放网关，并将 HTTP 与 WebSocket 请求转发到本地服务。端口占用时会依次尝试后续端口。
dsh-lanbuddy-pair 的功能「撤销配对设备」：用户在设置页点击解除所有设备，插件删除浏览器会话凭据记录；需要重启 DSH 才会让新签名密钥生效。
dsh-lanbuddy-pair 使用回环实例时会在局域网地址启动转发网关，默认从 3080 端口开始尝试；可通过配置关闭或调整绑定地址与端口。
电脑重启后，希望不用手动找新地址就能重新连手机。
I need a local QR pairing page so my phone can reach the desktop instance.

text:
dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 下载与安装 · 三步：**1. 装 App（手机）**

到 [**Releases**](https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-app-release.apk`（Android 8+）安装。

**2. 装插件（电脑）**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app dsh-plugin
```

然后 **dsh → 插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴 `dsh-plugin` 的绝对路径，按提示重启 dsh。（本包声明了 `dsh.bundle`，插件管理器才会接受它。）

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 下载与安装 · 三步：> **插件管理器需要 `pnpm`**。没装过的话，先装 [Node.js LTS](https://nodejs.org/)（一路 Next），再在 **PowerShell** 里执行：
> ```powershell
> npm install -g pnpm
> ```
> 关掉重开一个 PowerShell，`pnpm -v` 能打印版本号即可。官方说明：[pnpm.io/installation](https://pnpm.io/installation)。

**3. 配对**

1. 打开 **dsh → 设置 →「扫码配对」**
2. 用 App 扫二维码，或点「手动粘贴配对链接」粘贴二维码下方的链接
3. 完成——会话、模型、消息实时同步

token 每次启动 dsh 都会轮换，但 App 持有 30 天签名 cookie，所以重启不用重扫。

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 两套源码怎么拿：| 你要做什么 | 拿哪份 | 命令 |
|---|---|---|
| 改 PC 插件 / 自己接线 | `main`（本页） | `git clone https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app` |
| 改 Android App / 自己编译 APK | `app` 分支 | `git clone -b app https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app` |

- **只要能用**：不用编译任何源码，APK 从 Releases 下，插件按上面第 2 步装。
- **两套源码互不依赖**：插件是 Node 包（`package.json` + `lib/` + `cordis.patch.yml`），App 是 Flutter 工程（`pubspec.yaml` + `lib/` + `android/`）。
- **发版**：APK 走 [Releases](https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app/releases)，不进任一分支的源码树。

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 插件做什么：- **设置页**显示配对二维码（`settings.section`）
- `GET /lanbuddy/pair` —— 独立二维码页
- `GET /lanbuddy/pair/qr.svg` —— 二维码图片（`no-store`）
- `GET /lanbuddy/pair/info` —— `{url, host, port, loopback, lan, gateway}`
- `POST /lanbuddy/devices/revoke` —— 轮换签名密钥（所有手机重新配对）
- 回环实例自动开**局域网网关**

所有路由都过 `ctx.connection.admit()`，和 `/api` 同一套 Host/cookie 围栏；匿名请求一律 **401**。
dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 原理：二维码取自 `ctx.connection.authenticatedUrl()`，也就是 dsh 启动时打印的当前 launch token，永远是最新有效的。

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 局域网网关：dsh 只监听回环（桌面应用）时，插件绑定 `<局域网IP>:3080`（被占用就顺延）并把 **HTTP + WebSocket** 转发给本机 dsh，同时把 `Host`/`Origin` 重写为 `localhost`。无端口号的回环 authority 能让 cookie 在桌面重启后继续有效。

- 只在回环实例上启动
- `lanGateway: false` 可关闭；`lanHost` / `lanPort` 可改地址端口
- 安全口径同 `--host`：整个 dsh 面暴露到局域网，由 token/cookie 把关

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 手动接线：```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-pair" `
  -Target "D:\path\to\dsh-plugin"
```

```yaml

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: lanbuddy-pair
      name: "dsh-lanbuddy-pair"
```

然后重启 dsh。

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 安全：- 除网关外不新增端口
- 二维码/token 只发给已登录的 dsh 会话
- 所有路由 `cache-control: no-store`
- 「解除所有设备」会删除 `client-connection/browser-session` 凭据（重启后生效）

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 常见问题：| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 设置里没有「扫码配对」 | 插件没加载——看 dsh 日志，重启 |
| 手机提示连接被拒绝 | 扫到了回环地址，或网关没起来——重启 dsh |
| 提示 `not-a-bundle` | 包缺 `dsh.bundle`；确认用的是 `main` 分支 |
| `EADDRINUSE` | 端口被另一个实例占用；网关会自动顺延 |
| 重启后要重扫吗 | 不用，cookie 30 天；只有换 IP、过期或点了「解除所有设备」才重扫 |
dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · 卸载：在插件管理器里移除，或删掉 patch 条目与 junction，然后重启 dsh。

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · App 端能做什么：| | |
|---|---|
| **会话** | 与 PC 工作区分组一致 · 归档/恢复 · 置顶 · 重命名 · 搜索 · 子任务 · 后台任务 |
| **聊天** | 流式回复 · 思考折叠 · 工具调用芯片 · 停止 · 图片/文件附件 |
| **模型** | 读取 PC 目录 · 模型 → 思考深度两级选择 · 选择写回 PC |
| **交互** | 审批弹窗 · 提问卡片（选项/多选/自由输入/跳过）· 后台完成通知 |
| **多设备** | 保存多台 PC，一键切换 |
| **更新** | App 内检查 GitHub 最新版、校验 SHA-256、调起系统安装器 |

后台通知只针对主会话：子智能体结束不会单独弹，整棵 agent 树空闲后才提醒一次；`上滑清掉` App 后进程内连接断开，这段时间的通知会漏，重开 App 会补齐。

| Branch | What it is | Runs on | Language |

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · dsh pairing plugin + Android app：The APK always ships from [**Releases**](https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app/releases/latest) — never from a source tree.

Once the plugin is installed and dsh restarted: dsh → Settings → 扫码配对 — the QR lives here

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Install · 3 steps：**1. Install the app (phone)**

Download `dsh-app-release.apk` from [**Releases**](https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app/releases/latest) (Android 8+).

**2. Install the plugin (PC)**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app dsh-plugin
```

Then **dsh → Plugins → Add plugin** → paste the absolute path of `dsh-plugin` → restart dsh. (The package declares `dsh.bundle`, which is what the manager looks for.)

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Install · 3 steps：> **The plugin manager needs `pnpm`.** If you don't have it: install [Node.js LTS](https://nodejs.org/) (keep clicking Next), then in **PowerShell**:
> ```powershell
> npm install -g pnpm
> ```
> Open a fresh PowerShell and check `pnpm -v` prints a version. Official docs: [pnpm.io/installation](https://pnpm.io/installation).

**3. Pair**

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Install · 3 steps：1. Open **dsh → Settings → 扫码配对**
2. Scan the QR with the app, or paste the URL under it via **手动粘贴配对链接**
3. Done — sessions, models and messages sync in real time

The token rotates on every dsh start, but the app keeps a 30-day signed cookie, so restarts do not require re-scanning.

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Getting each source tree：| Goal | Branch | Command |
|---|---|---|
| Change the PC plugin / wire it manually | `main` (this page) | `git clone https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app` |
| Change the Android app / build an APK | `app` branch | `git clone -b app https://github.com/lrxG/dsh-app` |

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Getting each source tree：- **Just want it working?** Build nothing: get the APK from Releases and install the plugin via step 2.
- **The two trees are independent**: the plugin is a Node package (`package.json` + `lib/` + `cordis.patch.yml`); the app is a Flutter project (`pubspec.yaml` + `lib/` + `android/`).
- **Releases** carry the APK only; no branch contains a built APK.

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · What the plugin does：- **Settings page** with the pairing QR (`settings.section`)
- `GET /lanbuddy/pair` — standalone QR page
- `GET /lanbuddy/pair/qr.svg` — QR image (`no-store`)
- `GET /lanbuddy/pair/info` — `{url, host, port, loopback, lan, gateway}`
- `POST /lanbuddy/devices/revoke` — rotate the signing secret (all phones re-pair)
- **LAN gateway** for loopback-only instances

All routes pass `ctx.connection.admit()`, the same Host/cookie fence as `/api`; anonymous requests get **401**.
dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · How it works：The QR is built from `ctx.connection.authenticatedUrl()` — the same live launch token dsh prints at startup, never stale.

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · LAN gateway：When dsh only listens on loopback (the Desktop app), the plugin binds `<LAN-IP>:3080` (next free port when taken) and proxies **HTTP + WebSocket** to the local dsh, rewriting `Host`/`Origin` to `localhost`. The port-less loopback authority keeps cookies valid across desktop restarts.

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · LAN gateway：- Only starts for loopback-only instances
- `lanGateway: false` disables it; `lanHost` / `lanPort` override the bind
- Security is the same as `--host`: the full dsh surface is exposed to the LAN, gated by token/cookie

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Manual wiring：```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-pair" `
  -Target "D:\path\to\dsh-plugin"
```

```yaml

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: lanbuddy-pair
      name: "dsh-lanbuddy-pair"
```

Restart dsh.

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Security：- No new port besides the gateway
- QR/token served only to an authenticated dsh session
- `cache-control: no-store` everywhere
- “Revoke all devices” deletes the `client-connection/browser-session` credential (restart to apply)

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| No 「扫码配对」 entry in Settings | Plugin not loaded — check dsh logs, restart |
| Phone: connection refused | Scanned a loopback URL or gateway not running — restart dsh |
| `not-a-bundle` | Package lacks `dsh.bundle`; use the `main` branch |
| `EADDRINUSE` | Another instance holds the port; the gateway falls back automatically |
| Re-scan after a reboot? | No. The cookie lasts 30 days; only IP changes, expiry or “revoke all devices” require a re-scan |
dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · Uninstall：Remove the bundle in the plugin manager (or delete the patch entry + junction) and restart dsh.

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · What the app does：| | |
|---|---|
| **Sessions** | Same workspace groups as the PC · archive/restore · pin · rename · search · subagents · background jobs |
| **Chat** | Streaming replies · reasoning fold · tool-call chips · stop turn · image & file attachments |
| **Models** | Reads the PC catalog · two-level picker (model → effort) · writes back to the PC |
| **Interaction** | Approval prompts · question cards (options / multi-select / free text / skip) · background completion notifications |
| **Devices** | Remember multiple PCs and switch with one tap |
| **Updates** | In-app check for the latest GitHub release · SHA-256 verification · system installer |

dsh-lanbuddy-pair README · What the app does：Background notifications are main-session only: a finishing subagent never notifies on its own; the whole agent tree must settle first. Swiping the app away drops the socket, so notifications during that window are lost and catch up on reopen.

App source, build instructions and protocol notes live on the [`app` branch](../../tree/app) (`docs/PROTOCOL.md`).
